Name: This Is My House
Author: ArcsiHUN
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]It simply teleports farmhands back home to their own cabin if they try to enter one that isn’t theirs. It doesn’t affect the host, who can go wherever they want. If someone enters without permission, it sends them a private chat message saying: “This isn’t your house, so you’ll be sent back to your own cabin!”
Only the host needs to have.
That’s it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]As usual, it needs to go into the[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size]
